claims: The entity API supports dataset, entity, reference, CURIE, text, postcode, UPRN, coordinate and geometry-oriented discovery patterns.
WKT query geometry uses EPSG:4326 and geometry-relation semantics must be preserved when interpreting spatial matches.
Result navigation uses limit and offset with response links; large portfolio work should use bulk CSV, JSON, GeoJSON or Parquet downloads.
Current and historical periods must not be mixed silently; entity start-date, end-date and entry-date fields carry distinct lifecycle meanings.
API coverage and beta status require absence-of-result and schema-drift guards rather than treating a missing response as proof of no constraint.
Dataset tables expose entity, reference, entry-date, start-date and end-date fields.
Current downloadable data and historical records are separate views and must retain snapshot provenance.
A dataset-level reference is not sufficient to bind one of the three parcel candidates without exact response bytes.

quality_guards: Do not convert coordinate proximity into candidate identity.
Do not collapse entry-date, start-date and end-date into one currentness field.
Do not infer an authoritative registered boundary from a Planning Data geometry.
Fail closed for references 52040420, 52213916 and 52213412 until exact candidate JSON bytes are captured.
evidence_digest_policy: GitHub remote blob SHA readback after publish
